in_arabic.name: شرجيل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من شَرْجَلَ، يدل على الرفعة و العلو
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم شرجيل مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ش-ر-ج، و هو يعني الرفعة و العلو في المكانة و الشأن، و يوحي بالشرف و الكرامة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة و العز في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: شرجيل
in_urdu.meaning: رفعت و شان میں اضافہ کرنے والا، شریف و کرامت والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: شرجيل نام عربی زبان کی ش-ر-ج جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رفعت، شان و شرف، اور کرامت، یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں رفعت و عزت کی علامت ہے، اور جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان اس کا استعمال ایک شریف و کرامت والے شخص کی تصویر کشی کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: शरजील
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च पद और सम्मान बढ़ाने वाला, शरीफ और क्रिमटि वाला

in_pashto.name: شرجيل
in_pashto.meaning: د لوړوالی او درناوي حامل، شرېف او كرامت لرونکی

It is often given to baby boys in communities where strength, courage, and nobility are highly valued. A man named Sharjeel is expected to lead boldly, stand fearlessly in the face of adversity, and embody the bravery and confidence associated with this noble name. The name also carries an aura of prestige and respect, inspired by its Arabic origins and the lions that symbolize strength and courage in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sharjeel has a deep spiritual significance rooted in its etymology and the symbolism of the lion in Islamic tradition. A Sharjeel is believed to embody the qualities of the greatest Islamic heroes, such as Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), who fearlessly confronted adversity and spread the word of God. The name is also associated with the power and strength of God himself, and serves as a reminder of the inherent potential for greatness within each individual. Additionally, the lion symbolizes several spiritual concepts in Islam, including courage, fortitude, and fearlessness in the face of life's challenges. Ultimately, the name Sharjeel serves as a constant reminder to live with courage, conviction, and a strong connection to one's spiritual beliefs.
